key.text: A small night light for my dorm desk with a warm LED inside and a 3D printed cover. Just one, about the size of my palm.

output.summary: A palm-sized night light with a warm LED inside a 3D printed cover.

needs.why: Wire the LED to a small battery or USB power

routes.process: Solder a small LED circuit and print a cover that fits over it.
routes.fit_reason: This space has an electronics workshop and 3D printers in one place. It suits a student in Biomedical Engineering.

steps.title: Choose a simple LED kit
steps.detail: Pick a warm white LED with a battery holder or USB plug. Ask staff which parts they have.

steps.title: Take the trainings
steps.detail: Complete the general shop safety training and the orientation.

steps.title: Build and test the circuit
steps.detail: Solder (join wires with melted metal) the LED to its power and check it lights.

steps.title: Print the cover
steps.detail: Print a light-colored cover with thin walls so light passes through.

warnings.issue: LED gets warm inside a closed cover
warnings.fix: Leave a small vent hole and use a low-power LED.
